encoding.format: The layouts/unknown-keys case format: {"$bigint": "N"} is a native integer (yrs Any::BigInt, JS bigint), a plain number is a JS number, readers compare numbers by value.
encoding.board: A board layout map (layout_settings["1"]) as a newer client left it, with the group_calculation key (WP09 §1.6) and an unknown key.
encoding.fields: The fields of the board's database that read_cases resolve field_id against. Supported group-calculation field types are listed in group-calculations.json.
encoding.read: The effective board calculation every reader derives from stored: {type, field_id}, or null for the default card count. group_calculation must be an object whose type is a known CalculationType integer (JS number or native integer) and whose field_id is a string; any other shape, a missing key, Count (5), a missing field or a field type that is not supported reads as null. Readers never rewrite what they cannot read.
encoding.write: The keys the client submits, in the persisted shape. A calculation is written as the whole {type, field_id} object; Count all is {type: 5, field_id: ""}, never a key deletion.
encoding.writtenKeys: Exactly the top-level keys the write may touch.
encoding.expected: The map after the write. Key order is irrelevant; every other key, including unknown ones, is kept.

read_cases.name: the stored calculation reads as Sum of Amount
an absent group_calculation reads as the card count
a string reads as the card count
an unknown calculation type reads as the card count
Count all with an empty field id reads as the card count
a non-string field id reads as the card count
a native integer type reads by value
a field that no longer exists reads as the card count
a field type without group calculations reads as the card count
a select field reads its count calculation

write_cases.name: setting Sum of Amount keeps every other key
Count all is written as type 5 with an empty field id
a write without group_calculation leaves it untouched
